PLAN "12-week Meniscus-safe Strength for Recreational Skier"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and prepare for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Load Management" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Strength and Control":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower - Hypertrophy, knee-friendly":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
